meta.client: Word of Faith Church of God

facts.name: Word of Faith Church of God
facts.mission_supplied: Word of faith is a Pentecostal based church that glorifies the lord Jesus equip the saints and evangelize the sinners.
facts.history_working: The church began in New Brunswick, later moved to Neptune, and now has its own establishment there. Bishop Alexander McKenzie has led the church since 2007 and was not the founder.
facts.youth_note: Friday at the church; open broadly, with most participants age 17 and under.
facts.livestream: Facebook Live; stationary rear camera operated by media team.
facts.mission_display: Word of Faith is a Pentecostal-based church that glorifies the Lord Jesus, equips the saints, and evangelizes sinners.
facts.mission_original: Word of faith is a Pentecostal based church that glorifies the lord Jesus equip the saints and evangelize the sinners

goals: Make the website the reliable public source of truth for events, dates, service information, ministries, livestream, giving, and contact information.
Help local people searching for a church understand WOFCOG and feel that it could become their spiritual/religious home.
Support online giving through a proper third-party provider while retaining simple giving alternatives.
Allow church leadership to maintain recurring/changing content without editing source code.

audiences.current: An aging, predominantly Jamaican/Caribbean and Black congregation with some younger members.
audiences.growth: People across cultures who are zealous about a relationship with God, learning the Bible, community, volunteering, younger people and families.
audiences.principle: Intergenerational: modern enough for younger visitors while familiar, readable, and easy for older members.

differentiation: The people: love of feeding the community, giving back, and wanting to make a difference.
visitor_feeling: A place to worship God and Jesus, grow in faith, find community, and feel at home.
homepage_priority: Information first: what the church stands for, what it is about, how to visit, what to expect, leadership, and a sense that someone can make a spiritual home here.

brand.voice: Between formal church language and conversational language.
brand.palette_origin: Chosen for the website partly from the church's carpet/chair/interior colors.
brand.logo: Church of God denominational mark; obtain official authorized asset before production. Do not extract from Google Images.
brand.photography: Authentic WOFCOG photography desired; church can organize capture. Avoid pretending stock photos are the congregation.
brand.motion_direction: Moderate (6/10): CSS-led reveals, hover crop/scale, navigation feedback, subtle decorative movement; no constant flying/bouncing elements.
brand.visual_direction: More image-led and editorial than V1; stronger typography, asymmetric compositions, alternating light/dark sections, larger visual moments, less repetitive card-grid structure.

homepage_wireframe.purpose: Immediately identify the church and reduce visit friction.
homepage_wireframe.visual: Strong typography with restrained decorative treatment; authentic church image when available.

homepage_wireframe.purpose: Express spiritual-home positioning and who the church is.
Make the church's supplied mission impossible to miss.
homepage_wireframe.visual: A full-width burgundy editorial statement with oversized gold numbering/keywords; one of the homepage's memorable brand moments.

homepage_wireframe.purpose: Make giving understandable without dominating the visitor journey.

technical.client_framework: React only for islands that genuinely need state/interactive UI
technical.events: Compare Google Calendar-backed workflow with lightweight CMS; initial code should isolate event data behind a replaceable content layer.
technical.giving: External established giving/payment provider; never custom card processing.
technical.livestream: Facebook workflow initially; architecture should allow future YouTube support.

content_rules: Do not invent church schedules beyond confirmed Sunday 11:30 AM.
Do not invent leadership names beyond supplied names.
Do not publish unapproved historical details as definitive copy.
Do not claim a giving provider has been selected.
Do not use stock imagery in a way that implies depicted people are WOFCOG members.
Financial/tax member reporting is future scope, not V1.
unresolved: Exact youth-night schedule/frequency and formal age range.
Official Church of God logo asset and usage permission.
Online giving provider and public Zelle details.
Authentic photography and permissions, especially minors.
Facebook embed details and possible future YouTube workflow.

reference_direction.synthesis: NJCOG visual confidence + Victory visitor/church energy + WOFCOG's own warm intergenerational identity.

confirmed_programs: Virtual Bible Study — Thursdays 6:00 PM EST via Zoom
Youth Night — every other Friday 7:00 PM EST, in person
Annual Community Outreach — second Saturday in August
